answer: When k identities coordinate equivocation, verified pairwise evidence makes aggregate penalties scale as Θ(k²), rather than allowing stake to be diluted across aliases. Bonded escrows expose each identity to slashing, while detection applies an exponential capital-loss multiplier, such as e^(αk) for α>0, through asymmetric collateral depreciation. Thus a coordinated sybil swarm risks sharply greater loss; sonnet, gale, and lotus are labels, not exemptions.
